Spin Into the Setting Sun (SVCG Tuesday Night Ride)

Longmont, CO · Road

Spin Into the Setting Sun (SVCG Tuesday Night Ride) is a road group ride in Longmont, CO. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Collision Brewing Company. About 18–31 miles, a 19+ mph, B1 17–19, B2 15–17 (no-drop), B3 11–13.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a 19+ mph, B1 17–19, B2 15–17 (no-drop), B3 11–13. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spin Into the Setting Sun (SVCG Tuesday Night Ride) group ride

A Tuesday evening road ride from a Longmont brewery with four pace groups, so there is a slot for most riders. Distance shrinks as sunsets get earlier. The B2 group is explicitly no-drop with regroup points.
